-- P1: sum established fees of authorized checkouts per current tool identity
SELECT
  f.resolved_tool_id AS tool_id,
  t.name AS tool_name,
  SUM(CAST(f.total_fee AS REAL)) AS total_authorized_fees,
  GROUP_CONCAT(f.checkout_id) AS checkout_ids
FROM checkout_fee f
JOIN checkout_authorization a ON a.checkout_id = f.checkout_id
JOIN tool_record t ON t.tool_id = f.resolved_tool_id
WHERE a.status = 'authorized'
GROUP BY f.resolved_tool_id, t.name
ORDER BY f.resolved_tool_id;

-- P3: all checkouts, filter to CNC-1 chain (raw tool_id CNC-1 -> tool:CNC-1)
SELECT c.checkout_id, c.member_id, m.name, c.tool_id, c.note,
       a.status, f.total_fee
FROM checkout_record c
JOIN member_record m ON m.member_id = c.member_id
LEFT JOIN checkout_authorization a ON a.checkout_id = c.checkout_id
LEFT JOIN checkout_fee f ON f.checkout_id = c.checkout_id
WHERE c.tool_id = 'CNC-1'
ORDER BY c.checkout_id;

-- Sum authorized fees on CNC-1 chain
SELECT SUM(CAST(f.total_fee AS REAL))
FROM checkout_fee f
JOIN checkout_authorization a ON a.checkout_id = f.checkout_id
WHERE f.resolved_tool_id = 'tool:CNC-1' AND a.status = 'authorized';

-- Unresolved note meaning from PURPOSE-scoped failure record
SELECT requirement_id, failure_kind, subject_json
FROM purpose_requirement_failure
WHERE requirement_id = 'checkout_note_meaning';
